entities.summary: Olomouc Orthodox Church or Church of St. Gorazd is an Orthodox Christian church in the city of Olomouc in Moravia, in the Czech Republic. It was built and consecrated in 1939 and dedicated to Saint Gorazd. In 1950 it became a cathedral, because Olomouc is the seat of the Olomouc-Brno eparchy.
